summary: This is Part 1 of a Ramadan series exploring Surah Al-Ikhlas (Chapter 112 of the Quran) in depth. Sh. Ali Mashhour begins by congratulating the community on reaching Ramadan and emphasizing the blessed nature of the month as an opportunity for spiritual growth and constant progression (Ihsan). The lecture introduces the two chapters of Ikhlas (Al-Ikhlas and Al-Kafirun) as representing complete submission to Allah, explaining that these chapters encapsulate one-third of the Quranic meanings by covering Allah's names, attributes, and descriptions. Sh. Ali Mashhour then provides detailed analysis of the opening verses of Surah Al-Ikhlas, emphasizing the distinction between two types of Tawhid: the intellectual belief in Allah's oneness (Tawhid of knowledge) and the practical submission through worship (Tawhid of action and intention).
